data.gender_notes: Khasabah is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Khasabah is derived from the Arabic root word 'Khasaba', which means 'to strike with a sword'. In Islamic tradition, this name is given to remind parents of their responsibility to protect and guide their child with the sword of knowledge and wisdom, just as Allah protects and guides His believers. The name Khasabah carries the meaning “Sword of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khasabah usually hope their child will grow to embody sword of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khasabah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
